title: Published Manifest (input)
description: The accepts/emits/errors triple a served boundary promises a caller, plus enough binding metadata to address it. This is read-only input to the client-emitter: it is not admitted, parsed, or trusted by this limb as a capability grant — it is inert data staged as a digest-pinned read (§20 step 3). The emitter never widens what it was handed; it only re-serializes the same triple for a different reader.

manifest_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the published manifest's own canonical bytes. Copied verbatim into every emitted client so drift between the server's live manifest and a caller's stale client is detectable at the caller, not discovered at request time.

path.description: Absolute literal served path. No placeholders.

node_address.description: Base address of the serving node (e.g. https://node.example:8443). Required to build an absolute request in a generated client; omitted clients emit a relative path only.
